g.text: SOL payment and access: target flow for an already prepared server
Linux server is already installed, configured, and recoverable.
On timeout or reload, reconcile the same payment ID first.
A callback or transaction signature alone is not payment proof.
Retry only after resolving the previous transaction; never pay again just because it timed out.
SSH login is separate: sign a fresh message, then the daemon reads finalized access.
No order database or payment-triggered server preparation.
